faq.q: Will converting PNG to JPG lose the transparency?
faq.a: Yes. JPG can't store transparency, so see-through areas are filled with a color you choose (white by default). Convert to WebP instead if you need to keep transparency and a small file.

JPG for photos you'll email or print. PNG for logos, screenshots and anything with sharp text, since it keeps every pixel. WebP for websites: it's usually much smaller than both and every current browser shows it.

faq.q: Can it convert HEIC photos from an iPhone?
faq.a: Only in a browser that can open HEIC itself, which recent Safari versions usually can. In other browsers, change your iPhone camera to “Most Compatible” to take JPG photos, or export them as JPG first.
